name: Conversation
purpose: The pattern: header, role="log" thread of Messages, welcome state with starters, docked Prompt input.
description: The pattern that puts the Agent kit together: a header with the assistant's name, AI label and Context meter; a scrolling thread of Messages; and a Prompt input docked at the bottom. An empty thread shows a welcome state with prompt starters (Suggestions, `variant="cards"`). There is no Conversation component: compose it from the parts.
alternative: Conversation is a pattern, not a component: compose a `role="log"` thread of `Message`s, a welcome state with `Suggestions variant="cards"` and a docked `PromptInput`.

do: Say what the assistant can and can't do in the welcome state.
Ask before acting: route every write or send through an Approval.
Keep one primary button per view: Send, or Approve while an approval is pending.
forbidden: Never start a conversation with a wall of starters — four at most.
Never auto-scroll while the person is reading earlier messages.
Never stream into a region that also announces every token.
